description:
Walk with residents around South Lambeth Estate, most of which is still earmarked for demolition.
Hear about their experience of regeneration, 10 years on. And hear from campaigners about other possibilities -
there could be a better solution!

events.name: Walk with residents
events.notes: Join residents on a walk around South Lambeth Estate with Council officers to highlight issues that need to be fixed

events.name: Lunchtime Talk with residents about Retrofitting
events.notes: An exhibition of original drawings (tbc) & discussion led by Refurbish Don't Demolish will look at the next steps with architect Alice Brown

events.name: Retrofit and Refurbish walk with residents
events.notes: Led by residents, architect & retrofitters, join us on a proactive walk in how South Lambeth Estate can be improved after years of neglect

factsheet.heading: Research
paragraphs: Exploring the LCC archive for technical drawings, plans sections of the blocks. These will be used to develop an alternative plan for Lambeth South Estate to retrofit and refurbish the homes for the residents

factsheet.heading: Refurbish Don't Demolish
paragraphs: A group set up to provide advice and assistance to residents wanting to retrofit their homes and improve their energy performance, deliver lower bills, address damp and mould, protect from over heating and freezing temperatures, listen to communities, training and education.

travel_info: Additional travel info: Albert Road stop
